name: screens-first-design
description: Define a product's UX screen by screen: an invariant page schema decided first, then per screen one clickable mobile mockup + one spec fiche, parallel agents copying a bundled reference grammar (mobile phone frame AND desktop app frame — mobile first, desktop derives), preview verification before showing, a regenerable docs compendium + guided tour + team presentations, a same-day decisions journal, and a pre-verbal design check on every screen.
